newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau population up 12.8 percent since 1991.
newsitem.headline: Macau population up 12.8 percent since 1991.

text.p: New census data put Macau's population at 454,607, up 12.8 percent from a 1991 census, the government of the Portuguese-run enclave said on Friday.
According to the latest census, carried out in 1996, Macau has a resident population of 414,128. A further population of 40,479 regularly cross its border, the government said.
About 47.1 percent of the people were born in China, 44.1 percent in Macau and three percent in nearby Hong Kong, it said.
Just 0.9 percent of the population were born in Portugal and 4.9 percent elsewhere, it said.
Macau reverts to Chinese rule in December 1999.
